purpose: Audit whether the frozen long-term Adelie roster supports a longitudinal occupied-footprint comparison at sensor/product states compatible with the published Landsat-7 guano classifiers.

landsat.product_role: Level-1 imagery from which top-of-atmosphere reflectance compatible with published ETM+ classifiers can be derived

reference_etmplus.rationale: Align with the published 1999-2003 Landsat-7 ETM+ classifier era and stop before the 31 May 2003 SLC failure.

recent_oli.rationale: Recent OLI/OLI-2 comparison era; values must be transformed into the frozen ETM+ spectral space before applying an ETM+-trained classifier.

interpretation: Passing this audit establishes image metadata support only.
It does not establish usable local pixels, guano classifier validity, or sensor harmonization.
The recent OLI/OLI-2 epoch cannot be classified with ETM+ coefficients until the sensor bridge passes a separate recovery gate.
stop_rule: Do not change the epochs, platforms, seasonal months, cloud thresholds, or minimum scene/year counts after demographic outcomes are joined.
